summary: ARC Group Acquisition I Corp filed an 8-K announcing that holders of its units may elect to separately trade the underlying Class A ordinary shares, warrants, and rights commencing May 28, 2026. The units were offered in the company's IPO of 12,075,000 units, including full exercise of the underwriters' over-allotment option. No special-situation event is present; this is a routine post-IPO administrative step allowing separate trading of the unit components. The securities will trade on Nasdaq under symbols ARCL, ARCLW, and ARCLR. The filing does not involve any merger, acquisition, restructuring, or other special situation.
